title: Muslim ka Matam Hota Hai
body:
Hai girya kuna ruhe zehra muslim ka matam hota hai
Gham geen bohat hai sheer e khuda,
Muslim ka matam hota hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Gurbath mein na tha koi hum damm,
Zalim ne kiya har ek sitam,
Mehmaan bula kar qatl kiya.
Muslim ka matam hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shamsheer e jafa se kaat ke sar,
Aur jism ko paikja reti par,
Zalim ko na tha kuch qouf e khuda.
Muslim ka matam hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sheh kehtay hai Zainab se rokar,
Padti hai ruqaiyya par jo nazer,
Dil kapta hai behna mera.
Muslim ka matam hota hai
205
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kistarha baya is zulm ka ho,
Galiyon mein phiraya lashay ko,
Latkaya gaya mehmaan ka sar.
Muslim ka matam hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zilhij ki navi ko wawaila,
Yasrab ka musafir qatl hua,
Aankho se rawa hai ashq e aza.
Muslim ka matam hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Rote hai mohib sab peet ke sar,
Behta hai lahu aansu bankar,
Har simth hai shoreh aaho buka,
Muslim ka matam hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Majlis ki hai ghar ghar taiyyari,
Rounakh hai muharram si sari,
Aati hai sada e wawaila.
Muslim ka matam hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kya aae qayamath ki manzil,
Muslim ki shahadath se sahil,
Aagaz hue hai karbobala.
Muslim ka matam hota hai
